name: Jesús Ramírez Nava
focus: AI adoption · Team training · Custom web apps
positioning: I help businesses adopt AI with confidence: a clear strategy, a team that knows how to use it, and custom web apps that put it to work.
bio: AI consultant and web developer helping small and mid-sized businesses adopt AI: finding where it pays off, training teams to use it well, and building the custom web apps that put it to work. Google-certified Generative AI Leader. Behind that sits 10 years as a software engineer, from 16-bit microcontrollers and CAN bus tooling at John Deere to Amazon Fire TV middleware and the AI-assisted API backends I work on today. I've led teams of 10+ engineers, served as Scrum Master, and built the hiring and onboarding process for a growing team. Today I build and run web and AI products for clients, including a coaching platform and real-time apps for events. Based in Monterrey (UTC-6) and open to remote work with US teams.
